note: Risks, assumptions, issues. Likelihood and impact: low, medium, high.

risks.title: Unknown GlobalWave notice and exit terms
risks.detail: The contract may auto-renew unless notice is given months ahead, or may charge for data extraction.
risks.mitigation: Read the contract in Phase 0. Calendar the notice date. Negotiate data return terms early.

risks.title: Selection slips and squeezes implementation
risks.detail: Every month lost before contract signature comes out of implementation time or the buffer.
risks.mitigation: Hold the August 2027 signature gate. Secure a short GlobalWave extension option as insurance.

risks.title: Part-time admin capacity
risks.detail: Implementation needs far more admin and SME time than steady state. The current model has one part-time administrator.
risks.mitigation: Backfill or add temporary capacity during implementation. Weight admin burden heavily in scoring.

risks.title: Decisions anchored on the unchecked draft assessment
risks.detail: The source assessment recommends a vendor before requirements exist and contains calculation errors.
risks.mitigation: Track every open question to an answer in What we need to learn. Set criteria and weights before demos.

risks.title: Integration effort underestimated
risks.detail: COCC boarding, LaserPro, Identifi and Abrigo risk rating each need working integrations at go-live.
risks.mitigation: Require live production references for each integration. Prove them in a proof of concept if possible.

risks.title: Low RM and PM adoption
risks.detail: Relationship managers may work around a system that slows them down.
risks.mitigation: Include RMs in demos and UAT. Name super-users. Track usage after go-live.

risks.title: Data conversion from GlobalWave
risks.detail: Pipeline, covenants, tickler items and historical credit files must move or be archived.
risks.mitigation: Decide what converts versus archives in Phase 1. Run at least two mock conversions.

risks.title: Scope creep
risks.detail: Small business automation and digital account opening could pull time from the deadline-driven LOS work.
risks.mitigation: Decide scope at kickoff (D01). Changes go through the steering group.

risks.title: Finastra ownership change affects LaserPro
risks.detail: Finastra sold its US mid-market unit in June 2026 and may be sold in full. LaserPro's roadmap and integrations could change before go-live.
risks.mitigation: Confirm LaserPro ownership and roadmap. Require new LOS vendors to show current LaserPro integrations and an alternative doc prep path.
